# Frozen provenance debt: tests carrying no `UPSTREAM.md` row.
#
# Read by the third test in
# `crates/llvmkit-ir/tests/upstream_registry_drift.rs`.
#
# The list is a ratchet, not a permission slip: a test that is not here and has
# no row fails that test, and a line here that no longer names an unrowed test
# fails it too. Paying a debt down means writing the row and deleting the line.
#
# A line means missing *provenance*, never "no upstream counterpart". Clearing
# one means naming a real upstream source, or saying in the row itself that the
# test is llvmkit-specific and why.
#
# The backlog is inherited from the type-safety and pass-API programs; it sits
# in `llvmkit-ir`, not in the parser crates, whose waves add rows per commit.
# `docs/divergences.md` entry 98 tracks it.
